0.1: What are you doing in the laboratory? Inverse element-based magic? Hmm. The Maple World's resident genius in science, #b#p2012017##k, knows magic as well as science. I've never heard about inverse element-based magic! It's nonsense!
0.2: Summon is when you call your loyal servant using magic. Usually, a summon has the same or similar power as you. If you use a summon according to inverse element-based magic, it seems possible to use another element in your attacks.
0.3: If a human learns two different kinds of magic, they collide. To get around this, other element-based magic is realized through summons. That is the principle of #binverse element-based magic summon#k! Hahaha! What do you think of my idea? Isn't it perfect?
0.0: It sounds interesting, though. Scientists pay no attention to common sense! I'll help you out! The reason you can't learn two element-based magic is two different types of magic will always collide. So to get around this, Say... #bsummon#k!

yes.0: Good! You agree with me! Go and get ingredients to make #b#t4031451##k! I need #b10 #t04011005#, 5 #t04011003#, 5 #t04011002##k, and #b#t4031468##k. Go!
